entities.name: María Cegarra Salcedo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María Cegarra Salcedo (1899–1993) was a Spanish chemist, teacher, and poet. She was the first woman graduate in chemistry in Spain. In her later life, Cegarra was a councillor in her hometown, being the first female councillor of the La Unión Town Hall.
